dict_notice_1: Dictation uses your browser's own speech service. In Chrome the audio goes to Google, and in Edge to Microsoft, to be turned into text. Appuscholar never receives it.
dict_notice_2: Do not dictate participant names, interviews or anything that identifies a person.
dict_unsupported: Dictation works in Chrome and Edge. This browser does not offer it.
dict_btn_title: Speak to type. Works in Chrome and Edge. Your voice goes to the browser's speech service.
dict_err_not_allowed: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the address bar, then try again.
dict_err_service: The browser will not let this page use speech recognition.
dict_err_lang: This browser cannot recognise that language.
dict_give_up: Dictation keeps stopping. Check your microphone and try again.
